title.zh: 比特币因宏观数据与地缘冲突多次跌破关键价位并引发大规模清算
title.en: Liquidations jump to $547 million as oil rally hits crypto market

current_state.zh: 在 CPI 和 PPI 数据高于预期后，比特币跌破 80,000 美元，24 小时内引发近 9.48 亿美元的加密清算，使美国现货 ETF 持有者在其约 82,300 美元的平均成本基础附近陷入亏损。
current_state.en: Bitcoin slid below $80,000 after hotter-than-expected CPI and PPI data, driving nearly $948 million in crypto liquidations over 24 hours and leaving U.S. spot ETF holders underwater near their ~$82,300 average cost basis.

updates.title_zh: 油价上涨冲击加密市场，清算额跃升至 5.47 亿美元
updates.title_en: Liquidations jump to $547 million as oil rally hits crypto market
updates.what_changed_zh: 比特币跌破 84,000 美元，总清算额飙升 235% 至 5.47 亿美元，因伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡的局势升级推动布伦特原油突破 101 美元，较小代币以及 DeFi/meme 指数跌幅最大，Optimism 在 Abstract 成为一周内第二个关停的以太坊 L2 后下跌 10%。
updates.what_changed_en: Bitcoin fell below $84,000 and total liquidations jumped 235% to $547 million as an Iranian escalation in the Strait of Hormuz pushed Brent crude above $101, with smaller tokens and DeFi/meme indices falling hardest and Optimism dropping 10% after Abstract became the second Ethereum L2 to shut down within a week.
